$comment: appSourceUrl: the Microsoft AppSource offer of xrmverse. Leave it null until the offer is published; the home page then shows a 'coming soon' button. Set it to the offer URL to make the button live. registrationEndpoint: URL of the registration service (POST /api/register); while it is null the registration page is not built and the home button opens the Deploy to Azure docs page. unpublished: docs pages (file names without .md) that stay internal: they are not built, not listed and every link to them is rendered as plain text. repositoryPublic: false while the GitHub repository is private; links to repository files (and 'View this page on GitHub') are then rendered as plain text or left out, because they would 404 for visitors. siteUrl: the public address of the site (https origin, no trailing slash); canonical URLs, Open Graph metadata, sitemap.xml and robots.txt are built from it.
description: xrmverse is a server that speaks Microsoft Dataverse's language and that you install on your own servers. Your clients, plug-ins and solutions keep working unchanged.
